Draft schedule: reserve Tue–Wed 09:00–17:00 as Team A’s primary contiguous blocks; reserve Thu 09:00–12:00 for Team B’s demo prep and Fri 13:00–15:00 for the demo itself; guarantee Team B lightweight baseline slots Mon–Fri 08:00–10:00 and 16:00–18:00 for steady ticking jobs; designate evenings 19:00–23:00 and any leftover capacity as flexible backfill/hyperparameter-sweep time (first-come or prearranged).
